conflicts.permit: In addition, our Website responds to global privacy control—or “GPC”—signals, which means that if we detect that your browser is communicating a GPC signal, we will process that as a request to opt that particular browser and device out of sales and sharing (i.e., via cookies and tracking tools) on that Site.
conflicts.prohibit: Do Not Track (DNT) : our Websites currently do not respond to “do not track” signals.
conflicts.situation: A user visits the website using a browser sending automated opt-out / do not track signals.
conflicts.reason: Section 6 flatly states websites do not respond to do not track signals, while Section 14 states the Website does respond to GPC opt-out signals without reconciling the two.
